primary.name: Chrome for Windows
primary.description: 适合普通用户的最新版在线安装程序，由 Chrome 官方下载页自动选择系统架构。

en.name: Chrome for Windows
en.description: The official installer for most users. The Chrome download page automatically selects the appropriate system architecture.

alternatives.name: LYLARES Chrome 离线包
alternatives.description: 国内可访问的社区索引，提供 Windows 多架构版本、SHA-256 与代理开关。代理下载仍需自行核对最终文件签名。

en.name: LYLARES Chrome offline packages
en.description: A community-maintained index reachable from mainland China, with multiple Windows architectures, SHA-256 values, and proxy options. Always verify the final package signature.

alternatives.name: 苍狼山庄 Chrome 下载索引
alternatives.description: 国内社区维护的版本与校验信息页。当前正式版下载线路包含 Google 域名，不应视为独立镜像。

en.name: Clang.CN Chrome download index
en.description: A community-maintained version and checksum page. Current Stable download routes use Google domains and should not be treated as an independent mirror.

alternatives.name: 项目维护者备用下载
alternatives.description: 自定义来源示例。可在配置文件中替换为阿里云 OSS、网盘分享、组织制品库或任意 HTTPS 下载地址。

en.name: Maintainer-provided fallback
en.description: Example custom source. Replace it with an object-storage URL, cloud-drive share, organization artifact repository, or another trusted HTTPS location.

alternatives.name: Chrome Enterprise Bundle
alternatives.description: 提供 MSI、策略模板和企业 Bundle，适合批量部署与离线安装。

en.name: Chrome Enterprise Bundle
en.description: MSI installers, policy templates, and enterprise bundles for managed and offline deployment.

primary.name: Chrome for macOS
primary.description: 官方页面会根据设备提供 Apple 芯片或 Intel 版本，安装前应确认 Mac 的处理器类型。

en.name: Chrome for macOS
en.description: The official page offers Apple silicon or Intel builds. Confirm your Mac processor before installing.

alternatives.name: 苍狼山庄 macOS 下载索引
alternatives.description: 提供 macOS 版本、文件大小和 SHA-256 信息；当前安装包线路仍指向 Google CDN，仅作为国内索引备用。
alternatives.actionLabel: 查看 macOS 下载索引

en.name: Clang.CN macOS download index
en.description: Lists macOS versions, file sizes, and SHA-256 values. Installer routes currently point to Google CDN and serve only as a community index.

alternatives.name: 项目维护者备用下载
alternatives.description: 用于配置非 Google 的可信备用地址，例如阿里云 OSS、123 云盘、夸克网盘或内部制品库。

en.name: Maintainer-provided fallback
en.description: Configure a trusted non-Google fallback such as object storage, a cloud-drive share, or an internal artifact repository.

alternatives.name: Chrome Enterprise PKG
alternatives.description: 适合 MDM、集中管理和组织内部的软件分发流程。

en.name: Chrome Enterprise PKG
en.description: A PKG installer for MDM, centralized management, and organization-wide software distribution.

primary.name: Chrome for Linux
primary.description: 官方下载页提供 Debian/Ubuntu 使用的 DEB，以及 Fedora/openSUSE 使用的 RPM 软件包。

en.name: Chrome for Linux
en.description: The official page provides DEB packages for Debian and Ubuntu, and RPM packages for Fedora and openSUSE.

alternatives.name: 阿里云 Google Chrome 镜像
alternatives.description: 阿里云镜像站提供 Linux Stable RPM。该渠道并非 Google 官方发布页，安装后仍应核对包签名和版本。

en.name: Alibaba Cloud Google Chrome mirror
en.description: Alibaba Cloud Mirrors provides the Linux Stable RPM. This is not a Google download page; verify the package signature and version after download.

alternatives.name: 项目维护者备用下载
alternatives.description: 可替换为项目维护者审核并同步到对象存储、制品库或网盘的下载地址。

en.name: Maintainer-provided fallback
en.description: Replace with a maintainer-reviewed object-storage URL, artifact repository, or cloud-drive share for DEB or RPM packages.

alternatives.name: Chrome Enterprise Linux
alternatives.description: 适合需要策略模板和集中部署资料的 Linux 管理环境。

en.name: Chrome Enterprise for Linux
en.description: Enterprise download materials for managed Linux environments that need policy templates and centralized deployment guidance.
